sottotitolo: On your phone or computer, opened like any other app.
giaInstallata: You are already using the installed app.

android.descrizione: The app opens full screen and updates itself together with the site.
android.passo1: Open the downloaded file (from the notification or the Downloads folder).
android.passo2: If Android asks, allow installing apps from this source, then go back and tap Install.
android.passo3: Open GymMaster from your home screen.

windows.descrizione: A light window for Windows 10 and 11 that tells you when a new version is out.
windows.passo2: If Windows shows Windows protected your PC, choose More info and then Run anyway: the installer is not signed with a paid certificate.
windows.passo3: Open GymMaster from the Start menu.

ios.descrizione: Nothing to download: add the app to your Home Screen from Safari.
ios.passo2: Tap Share at the bottom of the screen (at the top on iPad).
ios.notifiche: From the Home Screen app you can also turn on notifications (iOS 16.4 or later).

altro.descrizione: On Mac, Linux and other systems install the web app from your browser.
altro.passo1: In Chrome or Edge: the install icon in the address bar, or the menu and then Install GymMaster.
altro.passo2: In Safari on Mac: File and then Add to Dock.

webApp.android: In Chrome: the menu ⋮ and then Add to Home screen.
webApp.windows: In Edge or Chrome: the install icon in the address bar.

versioneRelease: The download is the latest version published on GitHub.
